When the TPMA review process is complete and ready to hand over to data science for adding to the backlog for prioritisation, this brief contains the necessary elements required for hand off (including a link to the locally tested pull request to nhp_data containing the code changes requested). If multiple changes are being requested, please make a **new issue for each**.

The process for handover is recorded on SharePoint - contact @DCEW for access.

##  What type of change is required?

a) [ ] New TPMA (none to be retired)
b) [ ] Modified existing TPMA
c) [ ] TPMA replacement
d) [ ] TPMA retirement (without replacement)
e) [ ] Combination of existing TPMAs 
f) [ ] Dividing an existing TPMA

Please complete the elements below relating to the type of change selected above.

### a) New TPMA (none to be retired)

1. Human-readable name of incoming TPMA (if appropriate): <e.g. Frequent A&E Attenders>
2. Incoming TPMA code (if appropriate): <e.g. AE-AA-005>
3. Incoming TPMA subtype: <e.g. Adult, Ambulance Conveyed>
4. Incoming TPMA variable name: <e.g. frequent_attenders_adult_ambulance>
5. Incoming TPMA activity type: <e.g. A&E>
6. Incoming TPMA type: <e.g. Activity Avoidance>
7. Incoming TPMA mechanism: <e.g. Redirection/Substitution>
8. Incoming TPMA clinical group: <e.g. Emergency Department and Acute Medicine Activity>
9. Public text explaining rationale: <>
10. Link to nhp_data TPMA code PR: <>
